name: Opsly night agent queue (no ACTIVE-PROMPT shell)

meta.description: Cron in the Bogotá night window: Discord status + HTTP enqueue to local OpenCode via orchestrator. Does not write docs/ACTIVE-PROMPT.md (RCE). Import into n8n; bind credentials there, never commit tokens.

nodes.name: Night window UTC
nodes.notes: 10/40 minutes past the hour, 03:10–10:40 UTC ≈ 22:10–05:40 America/Bogota (UTC-5, no DST)

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "tenant_slug": "opsly", "agent": "opencode", "prompt_content": "Ejecuta la cola de prompts: lee .cursor/prompts/queue/, elige el primero con status pending, sigue docs/01-development/AGENT-PROMPT-QUEUE.md y deja la sección Respuesta agente. No esperes órdenes humanas." }

nodes.name: Enqueue OpenCode
nodes.notes: Header Authorization Bearer PLATFORM_ADMIN_TOKEN via n8n credential. Orchestrator must be reachable from n8n (Tailscale).

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "content": "Night agent tick: prompt-submit dispatched to OpenCode. Check GitHub Night merge + Deploy." }
